# Disassembly verification

Every reconstructed Emotion Engine function is compared against the retail disassembly, shortest
first. A checked row matches retail, or matches after the fixes recorded beside it. The length is
the distance to the next function in the image, so it includes any alignment padding.

## Embedded Python interpreter

The interpreter is CPython 2.0 compiled from `3rdparty/Python-2.0` with the port's edits. Its
functions carry no address tags, so each row maps the retail function to its upstream definition
by name. A source ending in `?` was placed in its file by the neighbouring functions in the image
and still needs its definition found. A retail name is a label from the analysis and is confirmed
or corrected when the row is checked.
